module: Unit tests of routeReference (parsing "route?key=value:scope", URL decoding, merging of explicit and inline parameters) and of the propagation of effective parameters to the onEnter/onMount hooks via ResolvedRoute and navigationContext. Run with: extensions.testFramework_TestManager:runTestFiles("routeReference").
notes: The testXxx(ctx) functions are run by testFramework_TestManager; the game does not call them in normal use.

testPlainRouteHasNoDecoration.desc: A simple route has no scope and no parameters.

testRelativeRoutePreservedThroughParse.desc: The route part stays relative ("./options") after parse.

testUrlDecodingOfQueryValues.desc: Decoding of '+' (space) and %XX sequences in values.

testUrlDecodingOfEncodedKeyAndDelimiters.desc: Encoded keys and encoded delimiters are decoded correctly.

testRepeatedInlineKeyKeepsLastValue.desc: A repeated key keeps the last value.

testBareKeyResolvesToEmptyString.desc: A key without '=' is an empty string.

testMalformedEmptyScopeTreatedAsPlain.desc: An empty scope is ignored (scope = nil).

testMalformedEmptyRouteTreatedAsWhole.desc: An empty route: the whole reference is treated as the route name.

testMalformedLeadingQueryTreatedAsWhole.desc: A reference that starts with '?' is treated as an entire route name.

testNonStringReferencePassesThrough.desc: A non-string reference is returned as is with empty params.

testExplicitParamsOverrideInline.desc: mergeParams: explicit parameters win over inline ones.

testMergeWithoutExplicitKeepsInline.desc: mergeParams without explicit ones keeps the inline ones.

testMergeWithoutInlineKeepsExplicit.desc: mergeParams without inline ones keeps the explicit ones.

testCanonicalReferenceReparsesWithoutQue.desc: The canonical reference (without query) re-parses without drift on reload.

testOnEnterAndOnMountShareEffectiveParam.desc: Reproduces the router construction (parse, merge, query, entry) and checks that onEnter and onMount receive the same effective parameters.

testRequestPersistsEffectiveParamsWithou.desc: The query stores the effective parameters and `fullRoute` no longer contains the inline query.
